About us

A family craft,
carried forward

Two generations, one shared belief: furniture should belong to the people and the place it is made for.

Our story

From one generation
to the next

Founded by the Dvořák family in 2011, our workshop is built around making: learning at the workbench, passing on techniques and finding better ways to solve the details.

Today, that knowledge meets contemporary design. We work with the architecture of the room, shaping kitchens and furniture around daily life.

From the first conversation to the final fit, the aim remains the same: thoughtful work, clear communication and pieces made for the long term.

15Years of experience
400+Projects
380+Happy clients
